items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's the show they had Josephine Baker, wasn't it?

ctx.x: That's the show they had Josephine Baker, wasn't it? I think she was in Shuffle Along, too.
I don't believe she was, we can check on that but there were a number of other musicians and composers who were involved in that orchestra. There was William Grant Still.
